Package org.apache.beam.sdk.io.googleads

Interface GoogleAdsIO.RateLimitPolicy<GoogleAdsErrorT>

All Known Implementing Classes:
GoogleAdsV23.SimpleRateLimitPolicy
Enclosing class:
GoogleAdsIO<GoogleAdsRowT,SearchGoogleAdsStreamRequestT>
public static interface GoogleAdsIO.RateLimitPolicy<GoogleAdsErrorT>
This interface can be used to implement custom client-side rate limiting policies. Custom policies should follow best practices for interacting with the Google Ads API.
See Also:
  • Best Practices in the Google Ads documentation
